title: The Scottish Chiefs
author: Jane Porter
description: "The Scottish Chiefs" by Jane Porter is a historical novel written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: The story is set in 14th century Scotland during the tumultuous period following the English invasion led by Edward I.

authorInfo.bio: Jane Porter (1776–1850) wrote The Scottish Chiefs. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
